description.value: Pedego Delta is a locally-owned franchise of the Pedego Electric Bikes network, focused on e-bike sales in the Tsawwassen community near the BC Ferries terminal. Pedego is a Canadian e-bike brand founded in 2008 that emphasises throttle-and-pedal-assist bikes sold through dealer-supported storefronts. As an authorised dealer, the shop would carry Pedego's full line of electric bikes and accessories.
